name: cc-askpass
description: Lets Claude run commands that ask for a password (sudo, ssh, git): a pane inside Claude Code asks you, and the password never reaches the model

remoteHosts.title: Remote prompts over ssh
remoteHosts.description: Answer password prompts from hosts Claude reaches with ssh

excludeHosts.title: Hosts to leave alone
excludeHosts.description: Glob patterns of host names; ssh to a matching host runs untouched, so its password prompts stay out of the pane
